positioning_summary.value: Harpsen positions itself as an affordable, all-in-one event workspace built by an event planner for wedding and event professionals, with workflow, payment, and timeline tools tied together.
evidence: Homepage: "built by event pros"
FAQ: "created by an event planner"

primary_differentiators.description: The founder story and FAQs emphasize product design from real wedding-planning experience.

FAQ: "one of the founders is a wedding planner"

primary_differentiators.description: The site repeatedly frames the product as lower-cost and flat-rate compared with competitors.

primary_differentiators.description: Harpsen Assistant and Harpsen Timeline are tailored to wedding workflows rather than generic business use.

missing_information: Exact company size is not stated.
Customer segments outside event professionals are not supported beyond general small-business language.
Pricing details beyond listed plans and trial terms are limited.
Integration set is only partially visible in the crawl.
potential_risks: Some pricing content appears duplicated across monthly and yearly tabs, which may overemphasize certain plans.
Blog posts and comparison pages could be mistaken for product breadth if read without the homepage context.
The crawl includes FAQ and testimonial content that may repeat the same claims in different forms.
profile_quality.notes: The crawl provides strong direct evidence for a wedding/event CRM, its core workflows, audience, and pricing. Confidence is highest for product category, ICP, and positioning.
